description: Stabilization sprint: fix all audit-discovered bugs before continuing new features

tracks.name: Auth Routers
tracks.description: Add userId scoping and ownership checks to all router endpoints missing authorization
acceptanceCriteria: All list endpoints filter by context.session.user.id
All get/update/delete endpoints verify ownership before acting
Unauthorized access throws ORPCError('FORBIDDEN')
agent.sendMessage verifies session ownership
agent.listSessions filters by userId
agent.getHistory/clearHistory verify session ownership

tracks.name: Server Infra
tracks.description: Fix WebSocket auth, event broadcasting scope, CSP header, and rate limiter
acceptanceCriteria: WebSocket connections with no valid session are rejected (no 'anonymous' fallback)
EventBroadcaster tracks userId per client and only sends events to the owning user
CSP header includes cdn.jsdelivr.net in script-src and style-src
Rate limiter uses sliding window (not fixed window)

tracks.name: Provider + Auto-Mode
tracks.description: Fix hardcoded permissionMode bypass and auto-mode userId
acceptanceCriteria: ClaudeProvider reads permissionMode from options instead of hardcoding 'bypassPermissions'
AutoModeService accepts real userId parameter (not hardcoded 'auto-mode')
auto-mode router passes context.session.user.id to service methods
sessionRepository.create gets real userId in auto-mode

tracks.name: Test Infrastructure
tracks.description: Align test runner configuration with test imports and fix fixtures
acceptanceCriteria: Root package.json 'test' script uses 'bun test' (matches bun:test imports)
Root package.json 'test:ci' script uses 'bun test'
All tests pass with 'bun test'
Test fixtures use correct ID formats matching schema validators

tracks.name: Config
tracks.description: Add apps/web to root tsconfig.json references
acceptanceCriteria: Root tsconfig.json includes { "path": "apps/web" } in references array
bun run check-types passes including apps/web
